en: Namaste 🙏 Your puja was performed as per Vedic rituals. Effects vary by faith, devotion, and individual circumstances — some see change quickly, others gradually. We pray your wishes are fulfilled soon 🙏 We do not guarantee specific outcomes; say “human agent” if you need to discuss further.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Puja vidhi ke mutabik hui. Parinaam shraddha aur samay par nirbhar karte hain — kisi ko jaldi, kisi ko dheere. Hamari prarthna aapke saath hai 🙏 Koi specific guarantee nahi; aur baat ke liye “human agent”.

en: Namaste 🙏 We understand how important Sankalp is. We can usually arrange the same puja again (or another puja) in the next schedule at no extra cost. If you still prefer a refund, tell us — say “human agent” to process with the team 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Sankalp bahut mahatvapurn hai. Aam taur par agle schedule par dubara puja bina extra charge ke arrange hoti hai. Refund chahiye ho to batayein — “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: Each puja is scheduled on an auspicious date — we encourage proceeding as planned. If you still wish to cancel, share your reason; the team can help with refund or reschedule. Say “human agent” with Order ID 🙏
hi: Puja shubh date par schedule hoti hai — jaane dena behtar hota hai. Phir bhi cancel karna ho to reason batayein; team refund/reschedule mein madad karegi. Order ID ke saath “human agent” 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 Dates follow the pandit’s auspicious muhurat — we recommend keeping the current schedule. Alternatively we can cancel with refund and rebook the next available date. Say “human agent” with how you’d like to proceed 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Date pandit ke shubh muhurat par hoti hai — current schedule par chalna behtar. Ya refund karke agli date par dubara book kar sakte hain. “human agent” likhein 🙏
